verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.asana.com (HTTP 200), and it tells agents to append .md to any docs page to get markdown. Many cited docs pages are served at .md URLs, including the webhooks guide, client libraries, MCP server docs and the MCP tools reference, which corroborates machine-readable, agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or curated agent index beyond the generic llms.txt header, and no first-party page describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering.
